structured_output.what_is_happening: BUTTPHIL here is a copycat of a live BUTTPHIL coin. The canonical token (HBDC...pump) is about 27 minutes older, has a $207k market cap and $3.5M of volume in the last hour. This contract was not launched through pump.fun. It was deployed straight onto a PumpSwap pool, with the LP seeded by the dev and 100% unlocked. That is why liquidity ($30.6k) is higher than market cap ($21.9k). It is 10 minutes old. It shows 2,051 unique buyers but only 57 unique sellers, which fits bots and confused buyers hitting the wrong ticker. Market cap has already fallen from about $30k at detection to $21.9k. Five other same-ticker PumpSwap copies in the packet already have about $1 of liquidity, meaning they were drained. This is the same template.

narrative.description: The BUTTPHIL meme is spreading right now, but it belongs to the pump.fun token HBDC...pump. This contract is borrowing that attention.
narrative.why_spreading: The main BUTTPHIL token is doing millions in hourly volume, which sets off a wave of same-ticker copies that catch buyers searching by ticker and sniper bots.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its only link to the meme is the matching ticker. It is not the first or canonical token and has no website or social links, except an unverified 'buttphildev' X handle listed on GeckoTerminal.
token_connection.competing_tokens: HBDC...pump is the canonical token ($207k market cap, $46k liquidity, $3.5M volume in the last hour). There are several dead copies: 2zhr, 6dMx, DXNZ and 2RYn, all with about $1 of liquidity, plus E9LQ and 7S5U, which have no liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: Buying is heavily one-sided (2,051 unique buyers against 57 unique sellers). GMGN flags 25 bundler wallets holding 19% of the top traders' share, and there is a 30-wallet trade-linked insider network. Creator status is 'creator_close'. The LP is 100% unlocked and was seeded outside pump.fun. Same-ticker copies built the same way have already been drained to about $1 of liquidity.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer count could partly come from real retail confusion. The dev could leave the LP in place for a while to farm more volume.

structural_risks: The LP is 100% unlocked and was seeded by the dev, so it can be pulled at any time
It is a copy of a live canonical token
5 of its sibling copies already have their liquidity drained
25 bundler wallets and a 30-wallet insider network
Price has already fallen about 28% since detection

structured_output.counterargument: If the canonical BUTTPHIL keeps running toward $1M+, overflow buyers could keep pushing this copy upward. It has thousands of buyers, a small $22k market cap and a dev who has not yet pulled the LP, so a short 2x before any rug is possible.

structured_output.thesis: This is a ticker-hijack copy with an unlocked LP seeded by the dev, sitting beside a live canonical token and several already-drained copies of the same kind. The most likely outcome is that the LP is pulled or the coin bleeds out. The chance of a runner is very low.
